records.name: Kraa 2.0

records.description: We tried to do the impossible. A text editor with clutter-free UI while being a text-editing workhorse. With a publishing platform to go with it. And voice support like you haven't seen before.

records.name: Cobalt
records.tagline: Your Kobo can run apps now
records.description: Cobalt is an open-source app platform for Kobo e-readers: a launcher, a signed App Store, a Rust SDK, and a capability-isolated runtime. One USB install; every app after that arrives over Wi-Fi.

records.name: Eventually
records.tagline: Your X bookmarks, emailed back as your personal newsletter
records.description: You bookmark posts on X and never see them again. Eventually syncs those bookmarks and emails them back a few at a time, on a schedule you set. Connect X, sync, pick your rhythm, start reminders. Pause or change it anytime.

records.name: Ticket Fairy CLI
records.tagline: Ticket Fairy event ticketing CLI & MCP server
records.description: Script your event setup, exports and reporting with the Ticket Fairy CLI. Install with npm, sign in with your own account, and get stable JSON out of every command.

records.name: IQ Routing
records.tagline: Trajectory-aware LLM routing that cuts agent cost
records.description: IQ Routing is a drop-in gateway. We classify each request, serve from cache, and route to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar and completes the task. The insight others miss: an agent is a trajectory, not a stream of independent calls. We route each step based on where it sits in the run: a cheap model on boilerplate, the strongest model on what matters.

records.name: The Million Sad Ducks
records.tagline: $1 makes one of them permanently happy
records.description: Pan and zoom the whole world for free. Pay $1 and one duck becomes permanently happy, takes the name you give it, and gets an absurdly official Certificate of Duck Happiness as a PDF. Six ponds from $1 to $1,000, depending on how dramatic you want your duck. Works as a silly gift — name the duck, and the certificate goes to whoever you're gifting it to.

records.name: Skydive
records.tagline: Build cloud agents that work across your tools
records.description: Build cloud agent coworkers that take on real, multi-step work across the tools you already use. Describe the outcome you want, and Skydive creates a working agent in minutes. No code, no prompt engineering, no workflow wiring required. Skydive agents live in your stack, execute repeatable work, and get sharper over time.

records.name: Sendra
records.tagline: Design emails in Figma, export HTML that works everywhere
records.description: Sendra is a Figma plugin that turns your email designs into clean, responsive HTML that renders in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and every major inbox. Select any frame you've already designed. No component library, nothing to rebuild. Per-element control over stacking, spacing and sizing on mobile, plus dark mode overrides. Every rendering rule is checked against real devices, not preview tools. Sendra hosts your images and sends a test to your inbox, so you see the real thing before shipping.

records.name: SpacebarX
records.tagline: A keyboard-first outliner for notes, tasks and projects
records.description: SpacebarX is a keyboard-first, local-first outliner for notes, tasks, writing, markdown, code, and projects. Capture and organize from the keyboard, add dates inline, and let Today collect what needs attention. Search across your workspace while keeping every note in context. It works offline and syncs through a cloud folder you control. Free forever. Pro adds visual views, saved searches, encrypted documents, version restore, Calendar, uploads, and BYOK AI.

records.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
records.tagline: The first natively multimodal model in GLM-5 series
records.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

records.name: Enter Pro
records.tagline: The AI-native platform to build and scale your apps
records.description: Building what runs a business takes more than code. Enter Pro is the AI-native platform that turns an idea into a working product. Plan, build, preview, launch, and scale apps, websites, and custom AI agents in one continuous workspace. Models, databases, authentication, hosting, payments, analytics, and localization are built in—so teams can ship software built for real business, not just prototypes.

records.name: Ojin
records.tagline: Talk to an AI Agent with a real face and voice, in real time
records.description: Human AI Agents have a real face and a real voice, and run live conversation rather than turn-based exchange. Interrupt mid-sentence, trail off, talk over it, and the endpointing holds. Setup is one still photo, a persona and a voice. No rig, no capture session, no script. Two face models behind a single API. Portrait for scale, Presence for expressiveness. Both drop into Pipecat and LiveKit. Try to interrupt it. Most demos cannot survive that, and it is the fastest way to judge this one.

records.name: GitNexus (Akon Labs)
records.tagline: The open-source kernel for coding agents
records.description: GitNexus (45k Github stars) is a Knowledge Graph Kernel that unifies every codebase in your org into one source of truth your coding agents can query. It resolves your code into a deterministic graph, so agents get exact callers, imports, and impact instead of embedding guesses, across every repo and SCM you run. On our public benchmark (https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks), coding agent runs 51% cheaper with GitNexus connected. It works with any agent over MCP.

records.name: Pluto
records.tagline: Your professional profile is now an AI agent
records.description: Pluto is an AI voice agent that learns your story in 10 minutes and makes you discoverable to the right people and AI agents. Most profiles reduce you to titles and keywords. Pluto learns what they miss, from what you are great at to what you want next and how you work best. It turns that understanding into a living professional profile that stays current as you do and represents the fuller picture of who you are.

records.name: HFlow
records.tagline: Scalable multimodal data pipelines for robotics
records.description: HFlow is an open source SDK for scalable multimodal data pipelines in robotics and physical AI. Define your own transforms, checks, labels, and enrichments. HFlow handles orchestration, storage, versioning, provenance, and curation, so you can inspect data quality and reproduce how each dataset was built. HFlow is built by Hebbian Robotics and is part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2026 batch.

records.name: Wondering Canvas
records.tagline: Visual ChatGPT in Parallel
records.description: A visual canvas of AI chat threads for understanding anything in parallel. Start a chat thread with a question and get an explanation with interactive diagrams instead of a wall of text. Spin off any key term or sentence into its own thread, ask related questions in the same canvas, and follow suggested next questions. Explore every rabbit hole while keeping your thinking organized in one place.

records.name: Traccia
records.tagline: Finally, a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane.
records.description: Traccia is a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane built for teams running autonomous agents in production. Observe agent behavior, evaluate performance, govern actions with policies and runtime controls, and maintain an auditable trail of what happened. Built with an open, developer-first SDK and OpenTelemetry, Traccia works across models, frameworks, and existing observability stacks—so teams can control their agents without being locked into a single AI vendor.

records.name: Lenz
records.tagline: Independent, multi-model fact-checking API for AI workflows
records.description: Lenz is an AI fact-checking API for products that cannot afford to hallucinate. It extracts verifiable claims from any text, then checks each one: searching independent sources, running multi-model debate, and routing through a review panel — returning a scored verdict with every source, argument, and step visible. Most AI tools give you one model's best guess from memory. Lenz ensures no single model's blind spots drive the conclusion. Available as API and MCP. Try it free at lenz.io/ph

records.name: Kira Community
records.tagline: Curate moments with #hashtag
records.description: Kira began as a tool for making beautiful things: turn a photo or a prompt into portraits, cinematic shots, videos. Now it's a place to share them, too. Kira Community is where your creations become moments. Tag your work with #hashtags, keep it on your profile, and browse a feed built around the themes people actually care about; and the people who care about them with you. This is Kira's first step from a tool to a community. Curate your moments, and share them with people who get it.

records.name: Savvy
records.tagline: An assistant that whispers what to say during a meeting
records.description: Savvy is a macOS meeting assistant grounded in your own documents, not the open web. Point it at a folder and it builds a versioned brief per client. In the meeting it stays quiet, then speaks up for exactly three reasons: they asked a question your brief answers, someone crossed a red line you set, or you pressed Advice. Every card cites its source. Documents, indexes and transcripts stay on your Mac; only excerpts and the audio stream leave. Apple Silicon, macOS 13+. Open source, MIT.

records.name: Yomi
records.tagline: A little cat who loves being read to
records.description: Yomi is a little cat who gets fed when kids read stories aloud. Speech recognition listens along, kids can tap any tricky word to hear it, and a simple wizard lets them make up their own stories to read back. Real stories come at three levels, so kids pick what feels right today. What's not in it: streaks, ads, accounts, or data collection. No one loses a 14-day streak at bedtime. Yomi won't teach your kid to read, it gives them a reason to practice. Ages 5–9, English & Finnish, iOS.

records.name: Speko
records.tagline: OpenRouter for Voice
records.description: One API for speech-to-text, language models, and text-to-speech, with public benchmarks beside runtime availability.

records.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
records.tagline: The open-weight preview of Qwen4
records.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a 125B multimodal MoE with only 6B active parameters and a new architecture built around QSA, Gated Residual, N-gram embeddings, and Muon. Its open weights give an early look at the architecture Qwen is building toward Qwen4.

Python clients and TypeScript helpers ship as aegis-latent-sdk 4.0.0. GitHub’s Release label is v4.0.1; source and attached package assets remain 4.0.0.

You can tailor the timer to your exact workflow by setting custom inactivity intervals, tracking specific inputs like keystrokes or various mouse activity.

records.name: READYACTION.ai

records.description: Most AI news apps are an RSS feed with a skin. llmbytes researches each story from the original sources, writes it, and links every source under the article. MODELS — price per million tokens, context window and capabilities for the current models, refreshed weekly, stamped with the date. No account. Works offline. Free.

In two minutes you'll have a clear map of where your strengths run deepest, which ones you're sitting on, and exactly what to do with them next... before someone else figures it out first.

Every card cites its source. Documents, indexes and transcripts stay on your Mac; only excerpts and the audio stream leave. Apple Silicon, macOS 13+. Open source, MIT.

records.name: CantFindJob
records.tagline: Job search help when the usual path is not working

records.name: Helm
records.tagline: Paste your site. Get a support agent. No signup.

records.name: Canvas Downloader

It features AI optimization to convert formats for tools like NotebookLM, Panopto lecture downloads, and offline transcription. Built for students, entirely private with zero tracking.

records.name: Sendra
records.tagline: Design emails in Figma, export HTML that works everywhere
records.description: Sendra is a Figma plugin that turns your email designs into clean, responsive HTML that renders in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and every major inbox. Select any frame you've already designed. No component library, nothing to rebuild. Per-element control over stacking, spacing and sizing on mobile, plus dark mode overrides. Every rendering rule is checked against real devices, not preview tools. Sendra hosts your images and sends a test to your inbox, so you see the real thing before shipping.

records.name: SpacebarX
records.tagline: A keyboard-first outliner for notes, tasks and projects
records.description: SpacebarX is a keyboard-first, local-first outliner for notes, tasks, writing, markdown, code, and projects. Capture and organize from the keyboard, add dates inline, and let Today collect what needs attention. Search across your workspace while keeping every note in context. It works offline and syncs through a cloud folder you control. Free forever. Pro adds visual views, saved searches, encrypted documents, version restore, Calendar, uploads, and BYOK AI.

records.name: Kira Community
records.tagline: Curate moments with #hashtag
records.description: Kira began as a tool for making beautiful things: turn a photo or a prompt into portraits, cinematic shots, videos. Now it's a place to share them, too. Kira Community is where your creations become moments. Tag your work with #hashtags, keep it on your profile, and browse a feed built around the themes people actually care about; and the people who care about them with you. This is Kira's first step from a tool to a community. Curate your moments, and share them with people who get it.

records.name: Wondering Canvas
records.tagline: Visual ChatGPT in Parallel
records.description: A visual canvas of AI chat threads for understanding anything in parallel. Start a chat thread with a question and get an explanation with interactive diagrams instead of a wall of text. Spin off any key term or sentence into its own thread, ask related questions in the same canvas, and follow suggested next questions. Explore every rabbit hole while keeping your thinking organized in one place.

records.name: Yomi
records.tagline: A little cat who loves being read to
records.description: Yomi is a little cat who gets fed when kids read stories aloud. Speech recognition listens along, kids can tap any tricky word to hear it, and a simple wizard lets them make up their own stories to read back. Real stories come at three levels, so kids pick what feels right today. What's not in it: streaks, ads, accounts, or data collection. No one loses a 14-day streak at bedtime. Yomi won't teach your kid to read, it gives them a reason to practice. Ages 5–9, English & Finnish, iOS.

records.name: Enter Pro
records.tagline: The AI-native platform to build and scale your apps
records.description: Building what runs a business takes more than code. Enter Pro is the AI-native platform that turns an idea into a working product. Plan, build, preview, launch, and scale apps, websites, and custom AI agents in one continuous workspace. Models, databases, authentication, hosting, payments, analytics, and localization are built in—so teams can ship software built for real business, not just prototypes.

records.name: Skydive
records.tagline: Build cloud agents that work across your tools
records.description: Build cloud agent coworkers that take on real, multi-step work across the tools you already use. Describe the outcome you want, and Skydive creates a working agent in minutes. No code, no prompt engineering, no workflow wiring required. Skydive agents live in your stack, execute repeatable work, and get sharper over time.

records.name: Layeraxon
records.tagline: LayerAxon: Stop Cutting Layers. Start Generating Them.
records.description: LayerAxon generates real, fully editable layers with AI from scratch. Unlike standard tools, it never creates a flat image to cut up later — layers are generated independently with zero pixel degradation and maximum flexibility. What you get: - Native Photoshop PSDs with clean, separate layers - Direct AE_JSON output for instant After Effects animation - High-resolution modes (up to 4K) & vector formats (SVG, EPS, TIFF) Generate → Download → Edit every layer instantly. Try layeraxon.com

records.name: Okivia
records.tagline: Okivia—your personal  AI interactive storytelling platform!
records.description: Okivia—your personal interactive storytelling platform! Here, you aren't just a spectator; you are the creator of the world. Whether you crave epic long-form narratives, free-roaming multiplayer interactions, or simply want to forge a deep bond with a specific character who has captured your heart, Okivia delivers the perfect immersive storytelling experience. Step into diverse parallel universes at any time and converse freely with characters who possess distinct personalities.

records.name: Free Edu Email Generator

records.description: UES Inbox gives you a temporary @ues.edu.pl address in seconds. No account. Incoming mail shows on the page. The inbox is deleted after 24 hours. Use it when you need a short-lived mailbox. It is not a university account and it is not proof of student enrollment.

records.name: Windfall 2.0
records.tagline: Track spending with Siri, Smart Entry, and calm budgets
records.description: Windfall 2.0 is a major update to the private iPhone money tracker. Type a sentence, use Siri or Shortcuts, scan a receipt, or share a PDF invoice—then review the prepared merchant, amount, category, account, and date before saving. The new experience adds Liquid Glass, widgets, budgets, spending trends, heat maps, smart alerts, multi-currency totals, CSV export, and optional On Device Only parsing, without connecting a bank.

records.name: Rieda
records.tagline: AI route planner for road, gravel and MTB cyclists
records.description: Rieda is an AI route planner for cyclists. Tell it what you want in plain language — "37 miles from Boulder, a bit rolling, quiet roads" — and it builds 20 loops, scores each on surface, traffic and climbing, and hands you the best three, back at your door. Ask for flatter, longer, or "as gravel" and it replans while you talk. Untagged road counts as risk, not tarmac: a road ride goes around it, a gravel ride goes looking for it. Road, gravel and MTB. Free for ten routes a month.

records.name: SwipeGallery - TikTok for Photos
records.tagline: The addictive way to clean your camera roll
records.description: You already spend half your day swiping through social media without even trying. SwipeGallery just points that same thumb muscle at your camera roll instead: up to keep, down to delete. Turns out the habit that ruins your screen time is great at fixing your storage. It remembers every choice, then everything you marked lands in a review grid so you can double check before anything actually disappears. All on your phone, nothing uploaded. Download for free, no account needed

records.name: StockDNA — Know a Stock at a Glance
records.tagline: 10 fundamental factors. One simple visual health profile.
records.description: StockDNA makes stock analysis simple and visual. Instead of digging through dozens of financial metrics, StockDNA evaluates a company across 10 key fundamental factors and turns the results into an easy-to-understand visual health profile. Quickly see where a stock is strong, where it needs attention, and what is driving its overall score. Built for investors who want to understand a business faster, compare companies more easily, and make better-informed decisions.

records.name: CompasslyHub
records.tagline: Navigate SEO with clarity
records.description: Most SEO tools give you massive audit reports full of errors, leaving you clueless about where to start. CompasslyHub is an MVP designed to bridge that gap. We turn static SEO audits into an actionable Kanban workspace, automatically re-crawling your live HTML to verify when fixes are actually deployed. Track your overall SEO health score, manage tasks smoothly, and navigate your growth with clarity.

records.name: Instashopsreview
records.tagline: Reviews & scam alerts for Instagram shops
records.description: InstaShopsReview is Google Reviews for Instagram shops, made by the people, for the people. DM-based sellers often dodge accountability — scammers just block you or hide your comment so no one else is warned. Search any shop by its Instagram handle to see 1-5 star ratings, written reviews, and photos from real buyers before you order. A Scam Alert section flags known scammers, so you know who to avoid, and helps you discover great local shops too

records.name: SaveEaseBot

Type a song name and grab the MP3 instantly. But that's not all. You can publish your own stories right inside the bot — share moments with the community. And every action unlocks achievements and leaderboard ranks. Watch your profile level up as you download, share, and engage. Absolutely free!

records.name: Fleets by Mridu AI
records.tagline: The agent that reads you before it writes to you.
records.description: Most LinkedIn tools automate sending. Fleets automates thinking first. Our trained models qualify every lead before a single message is written—no templates, no merge tags. The agent reads profiles deeply and writes something only that person would receive. Built as our own in-house B2B sales system. Human takeover when conversations get real. Managed profiles available. 50%+ acceptance, 35%+ reply from zero connections in 15 days.

records.name: Descrivo
records.tagline: AI product descriptions, auto-written in your language
records.description: Descrivo generates SEO-friendly product descriptions for Shopify using AI, automatically written in your store's own language instead of defaulting to English. Choose a monthly plan or pay once for lifetime access. Built solo and just approved on the Shopify App Store.

records.name: Openskill
records.tagline: Best platform to practice for your next interview
records.description: Openskill gives you realistic, voice-based mock interviews tailored to your résumé and the job you’re applying for. It asks relevant follow-up questions and evaluates what you actually say, not a generic sample answer. After the interview, you receive a detailed feedback report showing where you performed well, where you lost strength, and exactly what to improve. The feedback report is the heart of Openskill it turns every mock interview into a clear plan for getting better.

records.name: Unlimit
records.tagline: Global payments, acquiring and payouts through one API
records.description: Unlimit gives businesses one integration for global payment acceptance, local and international card acquiring, 1,000+ payment methods, multi-currency processing, payouts and fraud prevention. Local infrastructure across Europe, the UK, LATAM, APAC, India, Africa and the US helps merchants and digital platforms enter new markets while managing payments through a unified platform.

records.name: samla.ai
records.tagline: Snap a photo, get an instant catalogue of what you own.
records.description: You’ve scanned the shelf. Now what? samla.ai sorts it into rooms and boxes, tells you what the whole lot is worth, and writes the listing when you want to sell - straight to eBay or Discogs. Play the record on Spotify, stream the film, hear the audiobook. Open that box in the attic without opening it. Share a collection with people who’ll appreciate it. Export it for your insurer before you need to. Built for serious collectors of records, handbags and more - and for everything else you own.

records.name: Geo-SEO-Check
records.tagline: Check how visible your site is to Google AND AI answers

Free teaser, reports from €4.99. German UI, built for DACH SMBs.

records.name: X (@thexjs)

records.name: Audiline
records.tagline: Know what matters, without getting lost in the noise
records.description: Audiline turns your day's news into short, 100% verified audio summaries you can listen to hands-free, on your commute, at the gym, wherever. Free, with background playback, lock-screen controls, and zero tracking, your listening history stays on your device.

records.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

records.name: Ojin

Most demos cannot survive that, and it is the fastest way to judge this one.

records.name: Pipkin

Local-first on your own iCloud, no account. Predictions that show their reasoning. One subscription covers both parents. And it never tells you what to do with your baby. It shows you what your baby actually does.

records.name: Limonene ليمونين

records.name: Traccia

records.name: Storyflow AI
records.tagline: Claude + Notion but in One Intelligent Canvas

It builds from what's already on your board. Currently 3 years in development and early access. Free plan coming soon.

records.name: Wrkbase

records.name: فایل سحرآمیز

Use one of the 3,000+ spine photos the community has already uploaded or take your own! All the traditional app features too like follows, ratings, data imports/exports, etc.

records.name: ilogofy

Drift draws your life as about 4,170 weeks: the lived ones dark, the rest still yours. Three hours a night is five years of what's left. One honest tap a night. Five minutes on Sunday, then the week is sealed. Name what's running out - a parent you visit, a child at home - and Drift counts what's really left. No streaks. Nothing resets.

HFlow is built by Hebbian Robotics and is part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2026 batch.

records.name: GitNexus (Akon Labs)

On our public benchmark (https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks), coding agent runs 51% cheaper with GitNexus connected. It works with any agent over MCP.

It turns that understanding into a living professional profile that stays current as you do and represents the fuller picture of who you are.

records.name: Repertoire
records.tagline: Know what to wear. Keep your closet to yourself.
records.description: Most wardrobe apps ask you to create an account, upload your photos to their servers, and sync everything to the cloud before you've even tried them. Repertoire asks you to open the app. That's it. Catalogue what you own, get outfit suggestions built from pieces you actually have, and track what you actually wear, all stored on your phone. No account, no cloud, ever.

records.name: SMESolutions
records.tagline: Free UK SME Business Tools
records.description: Free website scanners for UK small businesses: UK GDPR and PECR cookie compliance, AI visibility, and email deliverability checks, plus invoicing and accounting tools. No registration, PDF report included.

records.name: Adoment
records.tagline: Cut RTO losses & automate your D2C stack
records.description: Adoment is two things D2C brands in India actually need: RTO Shield, which cuts cash-on-delivery returns with automated COD confirmation, RTO risk scoring, and NDR recovery over WhatsApp and a full workflow automation engine (Zapier/n8n-style) with 17 native integrations (Shopify, Razorpay, WhatsApp, Shiprocket, Zoho, and more) so you can automate everything else in your stack. Start with RTO Shield to stop the bleeding, then use the same canvas to automate the rest of your operations.

records.name: Fluxera Technologies
records.tagline: Fluxera,AI infrastructure that detects, fixes, and optimizes
records.description: Fluxera goes beyond monitoring and routing: it detects API and agent failures, quantifies their business impact, and helps fix them. Our launch introduces cost optimization, reliability recovery, performance optimization, and agent hallucination detection—bringing a detect → quantify → fix loop to AI infrastructure.

records.name: AIDude
records.tagline: Discover the right AI tool for any task
records.description: AIDude helps people discover useful AI tools without wading through outdated listicles or sponsored rankings. Browse 174 hand-reviewed tools across 20 categories, search by need, compare pricing models, and follow a daily Just Launched feed. Makers can submit tools for free, and every listing is reviewed before publication. The directory is updated daily and available in 10 languages.

records.name: Tablekard
records.tagline: Powering Smarter Restaurants
records.description: Tablekard connects diners, kitchens, staff, and restaurant owners through QR ordering, real-time queues, online payments, geofencing, and restaurant management tools.

records.name: LaunchArgs
records.tagline: Every flag you'll ever need. One click to launch it.
records.description: Build one-click launchers for your Windows apps by visually composing command-line flags — no memorizing switches. 48 apps, 400+ cataloged flags with plain-language notes, custom parameters, launch Stacks, a global quick-launch palette, desktop shortcuts. Offline, 16 languages.

records.name: OTC Trading Platform Development Company
records.tagline: Bring Your OTC Trading Business Idea to the Digital Market
records.description: Bring your OTC trading business idea to the digital market with a platform built to match your business requirements. An experienced OTC Trading Platform Development Company can help you turn your concept into a complete digital trading solution, from planning and design to development and launch. Create a platform that supports your OTC trading model, serves your target market, and gives your business a strong foundation to enter the growing digital trading space.

records.name: ShivGuruTattva — NirgunaShunya
records.tagline: Local Enterprise AI Agent Security Guardrail & PQC Wrapper
records.description: An ultra-lean ~291KB local middleware wrapper enforcing absolute post-quantum security and alignment for autonomous AI Agents at the execution layer. 100% network independent with zero outbound dependencies. Built on a <10KB axiomatic logic core, the engine features a certified 100% mitigation rate across 18,081 adversarial vectors, including 2,412 prompt injections and 3,156 semantic drifts. Test the live validation array firsthand via our website-integrated Replit sandbox.

records.name: AI Commerce Ready for WooCommerce
records.tagline: Get your WooCommerce store seen by AI shopping agents, LLMs
records.description: AI shopping agents are already recommending products to millions of shoppers — but most WooCommerce catalogs are invisible to them. AI Commerce Ready scores every product's AI-readiness, tells you exactly what's missing, and fixes it in one click: schema markup, GTINs, taxonomy, and structured Q&A. See what ChatGPT says about your products before your competitors do.

records.name: Checkpoint QC — film & TV spec check
records.tagline: QC your masters against broadcast specs in one pass.
records.description: Before you ship masters, make sure they pass the spec — not just that they look right. Checkpoint QC batch-checks a folder of clips against a delivery spec and reports pass/fail on resolution, frame rate, codec, chroma subsampling, bit depth, audio config, broadcast-safe levels, and file naming. Export a report to hand to the producer or client. Native macOS app. By a working DIT/colorist, who built it because delivery specs kept arriving as PDFs.

records.name: Workfry | Global Expertise Marketplace
records.tagline: Expertise Meets Opportunity
records.description: Workfry is a global professional expertise marketplace that directly connects enterprise leaders and businesses with specialized consultants, execution partners, and domain experts. Spans AI transformation, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, corporate strategy, chemical formulation, and industrial engineering. Facilitates direct collaboration using clear project briefs, milestone governance, and transparent budget structures.

records.name: Perpetua
records.tagline: Find and organize the accounts your family may one day need
records.description: Most people estimate they have 40 online accounts. Perpetua surfaces an average of 154. We analyze the metadata associated with your inbox and online presence to surface banks, subscriptions, utilities, and other service accounts, without ever accessing the contents of your emails. In ~20 minutes, build a private account map and leave your family a playbook for accessing what they need in an emergency.

records.name: MaxLite Part #: 105994
records.tagline: Maxlite's model 105994 light bulb uses 36W of power
records.description: LED light bulbs are the modern lighting standard, combining the best of energy-efficiency, product life span, and quality of light. LED lights are designed to replace older technology, and can find use in nearly any application. These lights use less energy than other types and run cool to the touch. Because of their cost-effectiveness and long-life spans, they're typically recommended over their older counterparts.

records.name: StarTarot for Android
records.tagline: AI tarot, natal charts and dreams — now an Android app
records.description: StarTarot is now an Android app. Tarot, astrology and dreams in one place: 20 spreads and all 78 cards, natal chart and synastry from real ephemerides, Human Design bodygraph, dream dictionary and journal. Reading with a physical deck? Lay it out, photograph the spread, and get an interpretation of the exact cards on your table — the photo is never stored. Plus a daily Today screen with your card, personal horoscope and an astrologer you can ask about the day. Nine languages, free to try.

records.name: Aartiq
records.tagline: For Questions That Matter
records.description: AI that can do things shouldn't do them silently. Aartiq is an open-source AI browser that plans tasks, explains consequential actions, requests permission, then executes — through a six-layer defense-in-depth security model with 525 automated tests. Every action is gated. Every sensitive command requires your approval. Your files, your device, your data — they stay yours. Plan → Explain → Ask → Execute One student. One question. One centimeter between capability and authority.

records.name: Osuite
records.tagline: Root cause and a fix, in under five minutes
records.description: Osuite is production intelligence for going from a P0 incident to RCA + fix in minutes. System breaks → runtime graph → AI investigation → root cause → fix → <5 min. Unlike traditional observability, Osuite correlates telemetry, code, deployments, and runtime context into a context mesh, giving both engineers and AI the context needed to investigate. An AI investigation agent works directly in your IDE, helping you understand what broke, why, and how to fix it.

records.name: fit.
records.tagline: fit. AI Virtual Try-On
records.description: See how clothes could look on you before you buy them online. fit. is an AI virtual try-on app for online fashion shopping. Add your photo, choose an outfit from a product link or garment image, and generate an AI preview of the clothes on you. AI VIRTUAL TRY-ON FOR CLOTHES Product photos show clothes on models. fit. helps you visualize an outfit on your own photo before you decide to buy it.

records.name: Citenzo
records.tagline: Track and improve your brand's visibility in AI answers
records.description: Citenzo is an AI-visibility platform: it runs your buyers' real questions across six AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, Google AI Overviews), scores how often your brand is named vs competitors, and shows the exact sources AI cites. Then it helps you get mentioned on those sources. Starts with a free on-page visibility check.

records.name: Lithe
records.tagline: Luxury intelligence for ecommerce brands
records.description: Luxury AI AtMost ecommerce products lose sales before a single word is read — the presentation just doesn't feel premium. Lithe fixes that. Upload one product photo, and get back a complete set of luxury ecommerce assets: polished product titles, descriptions, SEO keywords, and tags — all crafted to match the tone of a high-end brand. Built for sellers who want their listings to feel as good as the product itself. Free to start.elier for Ecommerce Brands

records.name: MedPhone
records.tagline: AI Front-Desk for athenahealth clinics
records.description: MedPhone is a HIPAA compliant AI phone agent for medical and dental practices. It answers every call, books straight into your EHR, and signs a BAA first.

records.name: RecoverSwift
records.tagline: Recover failed Stripe payments with AI — pay only on results
records.description: Recover up to 50% of failed Stripe subscription payments automatically with AI-driven, empathetic recovery campaigns. Zero upfront cost — 10% commission on recovered revenue only.

records.name: Popcorn VPN
records.tagline: No-signup VPN. Install, tap Connect, you're on.
records.description: Most VPNs make you create an account first. Popcorn VPN doesn't. Install, tap Connect, allow the system VPN prompt — you're on. No email, no password. Smart Connect picks a reachable server. Kill switch, split tunneling, and in-tunnel adblock are included (some tools are Android-only). Ad-supported on purpose: a short ad funds free servers; rewarded ads earn VIP time; Connect still works if the ad fails. We don't log sites, DNS, or traffic — only the metadata needed to run the service.

records.name: Arrow Domino: Tap Away Puzzle
records.tagline: Tap one arrow, topple the whole board like dominoes
records.description: Arrow Domino is a tap-away arrow puzzle with a twist no other game has: a fired arrow triggers the arrows it hits, so a single tap sets off a chain reaction across the whole board. The puzzle isn't tapping everything. It's finding where the chain starts. 651 handcrafted, solver-verified levels across nine chapters layer in color fusion, splitters, swaps, bombs, ghosts, walls, redirector pads and portals, one new rule at a time. Free, plays fully offline, and no forced ads ever.
